meta.title: +1 Speed Evolve Animals

sources.label: Roblox game passes API - +1 Speed Evolve (universe 10057343903)
Speed Evolve Wiki - best evolution order
RoUniverse - +1 Speed Evolve review (loop and progression cross-check)

notes: The seven natural evolution forms (Squirrel through Deer) and their sequential order are consistent across the Speed Evolve fan wiki, RoUniverse, GamelandInsider, and the official Roblox description (which names Squirrel, Chicken, and Fox).

Exact Wins costs and speed multipliers for the natural chain are NOT verified by any source. The fan wiki explicitly marks Win numbers as shifting between rebalance patches and tells players to confirm in-game. These fields are recorded as 'Not verified' rather than invented.
The 'tier' field is the Speed Evolve fan wiki's community ranking (C/B/A/S), not an in-game stat. Page copy must frame it as a community ranking.

Gamepass forms are confirmed and priced from the official Roblox game-pass API, not the fan wiki. The API exposes five animal-named passes (Ostrich, Alpha Wolf, Alpha Raptor, Alpha Trex, Alpha Dragon). The fan wiki only mentioned Alpha Wolf and Ostrich; the official API is the stronger source and is used here.
No item images are sourced yet. Natural forms have no official asset; gamepass forms have official Roblox pass icon asset IDs that the image pass can pull.
Win-shop natural forms are not Roblox passes, so they have no game-pass IDs.

items.name: Squirrel
items.unlockTiming: Default form every player spawns as before earning any Wins.
items.cardSummary: The free starting form. Every run begins as a Squirrel before you spend Wins on your first evolution.
items.notes: Base form. The fan wiki community ranking places it at C tier as the weakest, expected starter.
items.sourceStatus: form and order verified across sources; multiplier not verified
items.imageStatus: no clean per-form image available from any checked source; natural Wins-shop form has no official Roblox asset; shipping imageless (accepted)

items.name: Chicken
items.unlockTiming: First evolution to buy; the fan wiki says to purchase it as soon as you can afford it.
items.cardSummary: The first and cheapest evolution. Buy it immediately after your earliest Wins to start compounding speed.
items.notes: Also referred to as Hen. Lowest Win cost in the chain and the strongest early return per the fan wiki.
items.sourceStatus: form and order verified; exact Win cost not verified
items.imageStatus: no clean per-form image available from any checked source; natural Wins-shop form has no official Roblox asset; shipping imageless (accepted)

items.name: Rabbit
items.unlockTiming: Aim to own it before settling into World 1 farming.
items.cardSummary: The third step in the chain and a World 1 farming form. You must own it before you can reach later forms.
items.notes: Required stepping stone; you cannot skip to later forms without buying Rabbit first.
items.sourceStatus: form and order verified; exact Win cost not verified
items.imageStatus: no clean per-form image available from any checked source; natural Wins-shop form has no official Roblox asset; shipping imageless (accepted)

items.name: Goose
items.unlockTiming: The fan wiki suggests owning it around the first rebirth (about rebirth 25).
items.cardSummary: A mid-chain bridge form. Its Win cost jumps noticeably over Rabbit, so it usually lands around your first rebirth.
items.notes: Cost rises sharply versus earlier forms per the fan wiki; treated as the bridge into World 2 prep.
items.sourceStatus: form and order verified; exact Win cost not verified
items.imageStatus: no clean per-form image available from any checked source; natural Wins-shop form has no official Roblox asset; shipping imageless (accepted)

items.name: Cat
items.unlockTiming: The fan wiki recommends buying it before entering World 2.
items.cardSummary: A World 2 workhorse form. The fan wiki advises owning it before you push into World 2.
items.notes: First A-tier community ranking and a substantial Win cost over Goose.
items.sourceStatus: form and order verified; exact Win cost not verified
items.imageStatus: no clean per-form image available from any checked source; natural Wins-shop form has no official Roblox asset; shipping imageless (accepted)

items.name: Fox
items.unlockTiming: Targeted during World 2 farming, typically with rebirth 25 or higher active.
items.cardSummary: The game's mascot form (it appears in the game's title). A costly late-chain evolution farmed in World 2.
items.notes: Featured in the game's Roblox title icon. Costs substantially more Wins than Cat per the fan wiki.
items.sourceStatus: form and order verified; exact Win cost not verified
items.imageStatus: no clean per-form image available from any checked source; natural Wins-shop form has no official Roblox asset; shipping imageless (accepted)

items.name: Deer
items.unlockTiming: The fan wiki frames it as a post-rebirth-50 purchase.
items.cardSummary: The highest verified evolution and the end of the confirmed chain. The fan wiki treats it as an endgame, post-rebirth purchase.
items.notes: Highest Win cost of the verified chain. The fan wiki marks it S tier and the last confirmed form; rumored forms beyond Deer are unconfirmed.
items.sourceStatus: form and order verified; exact Win cost not verified
items.imageStatus: no clean per-form image available from any checked source; natural Wins-shop form has no official Roblox asset; shipping imageless (accepted)

items.name: Ostrich
items.unlockTiming: Bought any time as a Roblox game pass; it sits outside the Wins evolution chain.
items.cardSummary: The cheapest gamepass animal form. An optional paid alternative that does not replace the Wins evolution chain.
items.notes: Confirmed and priced from the official Roblox game-pass API. Optional cosmetic/alternative form, not part of the required progression.
